summary: Frontend-only regression of redesigned /app/live 'Command Center' layout. All redesign acceptance criteria pass: header + live-status pill, 4 bento metric cards with secondary rows (latency/temps/power/vram), tabbed TelemetryCharts (perf/therm/util) with active-state highlight and chart-stats-row (min/avg/max) rendered from real seeded telemetry, AlertSettings save with success toast, Reflex collapsible expands showing 4 tips (t1..t4), SessionSummary + session-reset toast, OBS Overlay panel present at bottom (streamer plan admin), Offline hero + monitor-launch-btn opening MonitorPreflight modal and closing via X, i18n IT/EN toggles chart tab labels and h1 correctly, mobile 390px shows 2x2 card grid with NO horizontal overflow.

issues: 'live.launch_btn' key falls back to Italian defaultValue 'Avvia monitor sul PC' even in EN mode — add proper EN translation in i18n.js (e.g., 'Launch monitor on PC') and matching IT string; same pattern used in a few other keys via defaultValue Italian strings.
Agent-update banner shows 'AGGIORNATI 9H FA' and header shows 'Telefono' in EN mode — pre-existing i18n gap, not part of this redesign task but worth noting.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add proper EN translations for live.launch_btn and any other defaults currently written in Italian via defaultValue in Live.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Live.jsx polls telemetry every 1s via setInterval — acceptable but for a long-open tab consider backoff when offline (data.live=false) to reduce backend load.
BentoCard renders '--' ghost values when null which is good; consider aria-live on live-status pill for accessibility (screen readers won't announce state changes).
TelemetryCharts uses fixedDomain=[0,100] for therm — CPU/GPU temps can spike above 100°C (throttle scenarios); consider clamping to [0, 110] or 'auto'.
seed_data_creation: Seeded 1 fresh telemetry sample via POST /api/agent/telemetry with admin agent token to ensure cards/chart populated during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Redesign is production-ready. Pro-gate path (PlanUpgradeBanner with testid live-locked) was not exercised with a fresh starter user — code path unchanged from previous iterations, so low risk. Login form uses input[type='email']/[type='password'] + button 'Sign in' (no data-testid on email/password inputs — pre-existing). MonitorPreflight modal uses data-testid='monitor-preflight' (no role='dialog'). Chart-stats-row observed: 'FPS min 130 avg 178 max 217 | ms min 8 avg 15 max 21' after seeded sample + previous 59 samples.
